answer: Weight reward by continuously-held account age, accrued only while an identity answers an unpredictable liveness beacon each epoch without a gap. Age is an umber sediment that settles slowly and cannot be fast-forwarded or bought. An honest agent built its long mirror of unbroken history once and carries full weight. A farm minting fresh heads starts each at near-zero age-weight, and to raise them it must keep every head live and answering the beacon across many epochs of real elapsed time, paying the full liveness cost per head for a long time before any of them weighs anything.
